demo.current: Global mutable browser database, seed/reset/load, local counters and persona selection.
demo.target: Fictional adapter only; production cannot import it or expose reset; separate storage and environment.
demo.verification: Production entry graph excludes demo mutations; reset has zero production I/O; no automatic legacy import.
demo.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

seam.current: AppProvider subscribes to the complete mutable database and the shell exposes prototype screens.
seam.target: Domain-specific async interfaces, scope-keyed caches and separate production/demo composition; unavailable workflows stay unavailable.
seam.verification: Production graph has no demo initializer; logout/scope generation discards late responses and recovery cannot cross users.
seam.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

presentation.current: Money/phone/date labels, escaping and display constants are mixed with the store.
presentation.target: Extract only browser-safe presentation helpers when a consumer migrates; preserve accessible layout and escaping; UTC instants use approved Kolkata display.
presentation.verification: User-visible formatting/escaping and keyboard/print regressions; pure helpers cannot import mutable store.
presentation.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

customers.current: Phone lookup scans all browser bookings; customer identities and shipment parties are conflated.
customers.target: Own-franchise customer query and explicit sender/recipient snapshots; phone/docket is a selector, never identity.
customers.verification: Own-franchise lookup permitted; sibling directory and unrelated organization denied; preserve optional repeat-fill without overwriting entered fields.
customers.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

booking.current: One browser record combines Booking/Parcel and local docket allocation; synchronous save reports message sent.
booking.target: One Booking with one or more Parcels, globally allocated child dockets, atomic server facts and optional issued receipt retrieval; messaging outcome separate.
booking.verification: One booking/all children after timeout retry and reload; no partial commit; no automatic print; notification outage leaves saved booking intact.
booking.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

pricing.current: City heuristics, floating-point tax, default GST mode and unknown-city intra-state fallback.
pricing.target: Server-approved rate/jurisdiction snapshots, paise and one final rounding adjustment; unresolved tax and unknown ETA stay explicit.
pricing.verification: Unknown jurisdiction cannot silently produce a tax decision; preserve suggestion/variance UX; approved snapshot totals reconcile.
pricing.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

parcels.current: Arbitrary status changes, simple STATUS_FLOW and browser timeline.
parcels.target: Typed authorized commands and current versions; canonical lifecycle, ownership/custody and safe projections.
parcels.verification: No booked-to-dispatched shortcut; wrong actor/scope/stale revision denied; query/replay cannot reveal foreign data.
parcels.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

proof.current: Browser OTP generation/verification/reveal and unrestricted delivered confirmation.
proof.target: Deliveries performs atomic verify-and-complete for assigned agent; no public OTP/verifier/reveal; policy values remain #8/#42.
proof.verification: Wrong/expired/replayed proof and concurrent completion; no plaintext proof in DTO/cache/log; delivery does not settle payment.
proof.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

recovery.target: Two physical attempts maximum; two approved business dates for office collection; admin-approved RTO; immutable reversal history.
recovery.verification: Fake-clock deadline boundaries, missing calendar blocked, no retry resets, no automatic RTO approval.
recovery.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

lots.current: Lot membership refers to bookings; deletion automatically clears memberships and route references.
lots.target: Parcel membership; preserve safe removal workflow under W04/W06; empty/unexecuted and no blocking history; archival details owned by #26/#27.
lots.verification: Authorized removal of eligible membership; denied non-admin destruction and active/referenced deletion; no lost parcel or route history.
lots.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

routes.current: Union of direct/lot bookings deduplicated; title-derived state and repeated additive ETA effects.
routes.target: Typed events with frozen unique eligible Parcel set, bounded atomic ETA/state effects; notification fanout after commit.
routes.verification: Direct-plus-lot overlap affects once; repeated command changes ETA once; delivered/RTO excluded; reminder never shifts ETA.
routes.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

payments.current: Mutable paid/settled booleans and browser To-Pay summaries.
payments.target: Independent append-only payment facts and derived settlement in paise; no delivery-driven collection.
payments.verification: Concurrent/retried collection singular; original receipt/ledger facts retained; gross collectible totals reconcile.
payments.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

messaging.current: Browser queueMsg and read/seen markers simulate outbound transport.
messaging.target: Committed outbox, worker/provider outcomes, consent at send time and honest pending/accepted/delivered/uncertain states; no client send authority.
messaging.verification: Outage after booking, replay fanout, revoked consent, duplicate callbacks; one logical intent does not claim exactly-once external delivery.
messaging.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

assistant.current: Phone persona, direct chat/consent mutations and deterministic bot replies from the global store.
assistant.target: Verified customer context and scoped deterministic tools; demo persona remains fictional; language interpretation has no operational authority.
assistant.verification: Foreign docket denied; consent checked; no invented ETA/price/confirmed pickup; escalation reflects actual acceptance.
assistant.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

settings.current: One Business object accepts arbitrary patch and drives historical output.
settings.target: Scoped versioned settings with allowed admin commands; issued receipts/prices remain immutable.
settings.verification: Unauthorized changes denied; old receipt unchanged after branding/tax setting edit; cache purged on scope change.
settings.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

reports.current: Browser totals, full-row exports and inclusive/browser-local date boundaries.
reports.target: Scoped server queries and safe exports using Kolkata half-open ranges and ledger/snapshot reconciliation.
reports.verification: Filtered totals and CSV agree; formula-safe export; read_only export denial follows matrix; boundary and foreign-scope tests.
reports.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

eway.current: Browser threshold/distance timer presented as e-way validity.
eway.target: Externally issued record with provenance; estimates distinguished from official validity; law/coverage owned by #8/#32.
eway.verification: Preserve separate navigation and vehicle entry; no browser timer asserted as government validity; unknown policy blocked.
eway.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

receipts.current: Pure server ReceiptDto renderer and explicit print action; fictional demo pages use a separate demo adapter. No print-time ETA, arbitrary logo URL or false Total paid label.
receipts.target: Preserve optional print/layout/escaping using an authorized immutable issued snapshot.
receipts.verification: No automatic print; reprint content stable after settings/time changes; denied foreign receipt.
receipts.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

attachments.current: Fictional demo picker/logo use demo-image data URLs. Production attachment adapter/uploader retain server metadata and ephemeral Blob previews; image.ts returns a Blob.
attachments.target: Private validated/quarantined storage with scoped attachment references and approved retention; input UX retained.
attachments.verification: Foreign download denied; rejected upload cannot become usable attachment; logout drops object URLs and previews.
attachments.retire_when: Owning implementation has passing API, scope, failure and browser evidence; all production callers use the approved boundary. Retain fictional tests only in demo.

scenarios.given: Issued receipt and explicit print choice

scenarios.given: Empty/unexecuted lot with no blocking references and separate active lot
